people.name: HOCART, Arthur Maurice – Persons of Indian Studies by Prof. Dr. Klaus Karttunen

relations.subject: Arthur Maurice Hocart
relations.evidence: Graduated 1906 from Oxford (Exeter College) in classics

relations.subject: Arthur Maurice Hocart
relations.evidence: In 1908–09 participated in W. H. R. Rivers’ ethnological expedition to the Solomon Islands.

relations.subject: Arthur Maurice Hocart
relations.evidence: in 1912–14 Graduate Research Scholar of Exeter College and Jesus College for Pacific Studies in Oxford

relations.subject: Arthur Maurice Hocart
relations.evidence: In 1915 Reader in Mental Philosophy at Oxford.

relations.subject: Arthur Maurice Hocart
relations.evidence: Archaeological Commissioner of Ceylon from 1921, retired 1929 because of health problems.

relations.subject: Arthur Maurice Hocart
relations.evidence: In 1931-34 Honorary Lecturer in Ethnology at London University College

relations.subject: Arthur Maurice Hocart
relations.evidence: from 1934 Professor of Sociology at Cairo.

relations.subject: Arthur Maurice Hocart
relations.evidence: founded and edited the Ceylon Journal of Science
